text:
ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens, wilted and glossy with a slight sheen, mixed with some bright green spinach-like leaves and thin pale stems, spread across the right half of the plate in a loose heap about 12 cm across and 1 cm high, with small red pepper flakes or chopped red bits scattered through it | 60
ITEM 2 | Light green and pale leafy greens (rocket-like, with lobed edges) lying on top of the dark greens at the upper right, loose and slightly dry-looking, covering about 8 cm by 6 cm and 1 cm high | 25
ITEM 3 | Golden-breaded or crumbed pieces with a rough, crumbly, lightly browned surface and visible flaky grain, several chunks about 2 to 3 cm each, piled at the lower left and partly covered by greens, with a few darker flecks | 55
ITEM 4 | Pale orange-yellow chunk, soft-looking with a smooth surface and slight translucence, about 3 cm across, sitting beside the breaded pieces at the left edge | 12
ITEM 5 | Small pieces of red pepper, bright red and glossy, about 1 cm long, scattered among the greens and on the breaded pieces | 5
ITEM 6 | Thin reddish-brown sauce smear with slight oiliness along the lower and right edges of the plate, with a few dots of dried brown residue | 8
ITEM 7 | Black pepper flecks, dry and dark, scattered in small specks across the upper left of the plate near the crumbs | 1
